Create one standalone production-ready negative-status icon for TINNITUS in a dark fantasy RPG. Square black iron tablet with a thin aged antique-gold double border, four pointed diamond corner ornaments, worn gilded scratches; dark charcoal stone inner background. Painterly realistic subject: a clearly recognizable single human ear, rendered like a pale carved silver-and-ivory relief seen three-quarter from the side. Around the ear are two broken concentric lavender-and-amber acoustic rings and sharp small pale ringing vibration strokes, showing unbearable magical ringing and sonic disorientation. A subtle cracked bell shape behind the ear can hint at the ringing but must remain secondary. Strong central silhouette recognizable at 32 and 64px, high contrast, restrained violet/white/antique-gold glow, detailed painterly brush and metal texture matching premium dark fantasy tabletop UI. No face, head portrait, gore, blood, modern device, headphones, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, logo or text. Keep the outer square ornament complete and a little transparent safe margin around it. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the framed tablet. Exactly one icon on a square canvas.
